norm_type.description: type of the used p-norm. Can be ``'inf'`` for infinity norm.

error_if_nonfinite.description: if True, an error is thrown if the total norm of :attr:`tensors` is ``nan``, ``inf``, or ``-inf``. Default: ``False``

foreach.description: use the faster foreach-based implementation. If ``None``, use the foreach implementation for CUDA and CPU native tensors and silently fall back to the slow implementation for other device types. Default: ``None``

output.description: Total norm of the tensors (viewed as a single vector).
